The tokenizer is fine. Let me trace key cases:

- `''` → no chars, `finishState`: nothing touched → `[]`. ✓
- `'\n'` → `finishField` pushes `''`, `finishRecord` → `[['']]`. ✓
- `'a,one\r'` then `'\nb,two'`: `\r` sets `pendingCR`; next char `\n` → `consumeLine` finishes record. ✓
- `'a,one\r'` end: `pendingCR` → `BARE_CR`. ✓
- `'a,"say "'` + `'"hi"""'`: quoted → `afterQuote` on `"`; next `"` → literal `"`, back to `quoted`; `hi`; `"` → `afterQuote`; `"` → literal `"`; `"` → `afterQuote`; end → `finishState` mode `afterQuote` (not `quoted`) → record `['a','say "hi"']`. ✓
- `'"a"x'` → `afterQuote` then `x` → `INVALID_QUOTE`. ✓
- `'a"b'` → plain, `atFieldStart` false → `INVALID_QUOTE`. ✓
- `'a,"b'` end → mode `quoted` → `UNTERMINATED_QUOTE`. ✓
- `'a,b\r\r\n'` → first `\r` pending, next `\r` → `BARE_CR`. ✓
- `'a,b\r'` + `'c'` → `BARE_CR`. ✓
- `'a,b\n'` → record, then `finishState` untouched → no extra record. ✓
- `'a,b\n\n'` → `[['a','b'],['']]`. ✓
- `'a,"b\r\nc"'` → CRLF inside quotes preserved literally. ✓
- `'a,"b"'` then `','` → `afterQuote` + `,` → `finishField` (field `b`), `atFieldStart` true. ✓
- `'a,"b",'` end → fields `['a','b']`, then `finishState`: `touched` true → `finishField` pushes `''` → `['a','b','']`. ✓
- `'a,'` end → `['a','']`. ✓
- `'a'` end → `['a']`. ✓
- `'""'` → quoted, `"` → afterQuote, end → `['']`. ✓
- `'""""'` → quoted, `"`→afterQuote, `"`→literal `"` quoted, `"`→afterQuote, end → `['"']`. ✓

One concern: `atFieldStart` after a quoted field closes and then a comma — `finishField` resets it to `true`. ✓ And after `afterQuote` → `\r`/`\n`, `finishField` resets it. ✓

Also `touched` after `afterQuote` → `\r`/`\n`: `finishRecord` resets `touched=false`. ✓

Consumers: `readItems`/`countItems` both call `parseRows` and `validateItemRow`, so they agree. `countItems` validates all rows before returning count. ✓

Everything checks out. Both files are within the allowed writable set.

## Summary

**Root causes found in `src/state.mjs` / `src/line.mjs`:**
1. `pendingCR` was never set, so `\r` finished a record immediately. A CRLF split across chunks produced an extra empty record, and a bare CR was silently accepted instead of raising `BARE_CR`.
2. In `afterQuote` mode, a following `"` threw `INVALID_QUOTE` instead of treating `""` as one literal quote, so doubled quotes split across chunks failed.
3. `consumeLine` accepted any character after a CR (it only finished the record on CR/LF and otherwise ignored the char), losing data and never reporting a bare CR.

**Changes:**
- `src/line.mjs`: `consumeLine` now clears `pendingCR`, finishes the record only on `\n`, and otherwise throws `SyntaxError` with `.code === 'BARE_CR'`.
- `src/state.mjs`: `\r` outside quotes now sets `pendingCR` (deferring the decision to the next char, so chunk boundaries are irrelevant); `afterQuote` + `"` appends a literal `"` and returns to `quoted`; `afterQuote` + `,`/CR/LF handled explicitly; any other char after a closing quote throws `INVALID_QUOTE`. `finishState` still reports `BARE_CR` for a trailing CR and `UNTERMINATED_QUOTE` for an open quoted field.

`src/tokenizer.mjs`, the consumers, and the helpers were already correct and were left unchanged, so `parseRows`, `readItems`, and `countItems` share one parser and one error path.

**Verification:** I traced the grammar cases by hand (empty input, blank lines, trailing line ending, final record without ending, CRLF split across chunks, bare CR at end and mid-input, doubled quotes split across chunks, quoted CRLF content, `INVALID_QUOTE` for quote-in-plain and trailing junk, `UNTERMINATED_QUOTE`, empty fields). No tests were executed — there is no shell/test runner available in this environment, so I cannot claim the public tests pass.
